core.cn: 核心意象：一支端头泛红的细白烟卷。

branches.en: The thin paper roll is the central sense.
branches.cn: 细纸卷是核心义项。

branches.en: The smoke carries the same name in daily talk.
branches.cn: 在日常说法里，烟也带着同一个名字。

branches.en: Roll and smoke appear together in one breath.
branches.cn: 烟卷与烟常常在同一口气里出现。

branches.en: The suffix marks the smaller size of the roll.
branches.cn: 后缀标记出这种烟卷更小的尺寸。

branches.en: The smoke is what remains after the roll burns.
branches.cn: 烟是烟卷燃尽之后留下的东西。

intro.en: The stem builds a plural, two clippings and a compound, all from the same base.
intro.cn: 这个词干构成复数、两个缩略形式和一个复合词，都出自同一词基。

latinIntro.en: The base cigare is French, and the suffix -ette is a French diminutive.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 cigare 属法语，后缀 -ette 也是法语指小成分。

items.example: A cigarette burned in the ashtray.
items.exampleCN: 一支香烟在烟灰缸里燃着。

items.example: He bought two packs of cigarettes.
He stepped out for a cig.

items.meaning: a tube that holds a cigarette
items.example: The actor used a long cigarette holder.
items.exampleCN: 这位演员用了一支长烟嘴。

items.meaning: a smaller version of the base

items.example: Tobacco is cut very fine for cigarettes.
items.exampleCN: 香烟用的烟叶切得很细。

items.meaning: the cloud given off by burning

latinEntries.example: Cigare plus -ette became cigarette.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cigare 加 -ette 变成了 cigarette。

definition_en: a building where films are shown, films as an art form, or a single showing of a film
core_image: 暗厅里一束光穿过浮尘打在银幕上
scene: 灯一暗，屏幕上的画面慢慢亮起来。We went to the cinema on a rainy afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 cinema 指「电影院」（第 1 个义项：放映电影的场所）；句意是我们在一个下雨的午后去了电影院。

derivatives.zh: 电影的；电影般有感染力的

senses.title: A place showing films
senses.definition: a building where films are shown to the public
senses.definitionCN: 向公众放映电影的场所
senses.example: We went to the cinema on a rainy afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在一个下雨的午后去了电影院。
senses.why: The French name of the moving picture machine was shortened, and the hall that used it took the short form.
senses.whyCN: 法语中那台活动影像机器的名字被缩短，使用它的厅堂便用了这个短形式。

senses.title: Films as an art
senses.definition: films considered as an art form or as an industry
senses.definitionCN: 被视为艺术形式或产业的电影
senses.example: He has worked in the cinema for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在电影界工作了三十年。
senses.why: The name of the machine widened from the device to the art it produced.
senses.whyCN: 那台机器的名字从装置扩展到它所创造的艺术。

senses.title: A single film showing
senses.definition: one showing of a film at a fixed time
senses.definitionCN: 在固定时间放映的一场电影
senses.example: The evening cinema starts at eight.
senses.exampleCN: 晚场电影八点开始。
senses.why: The place and the event shared one noun, as with many public buildings.
senses.whyCN: 场所与活动共用一个名词，许多公共建筑都是如此。

intro.en: Cinema is a short form of the French name for a machine that recorded movement.
intro.cn: cinema 是一个法语名字的缩短形式，那台机器专门记录运动。

items.en: Kinema meant movement.
items.cn: kinema 意为运动。

items.en: Cinematographe named a machine that photographed movement.
items.cn: cinematographe 指拍摄运动影像的机器。

items.en: English shortened the long name to cinema.
items.cn: 英语把这个长名字缩短成 cinema。

items.en: The word moved from the machine to the hall and to the art.
items.cn: 这个词从机器转到厅堂，再转到艺术。

items.en: Cinema now covers the place, the showing and the industry.
items.cn: cinema 现在覆盖场所、放映活动与整个产业。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the soft c opening, while the meaning group names places and films.
note.cn: 形近组保持柔软的 c 开头，近义组列出场所与影片。

entries.definition: a sweet spice made from tree bark
entries.definitionCN: 用树皮制成的甜香香料

entries.definition: the usual weather of a region
entries.definitionCN: 一个地区通常的天气状况

entries.definition: a formal public event with fixed actions
entries.definitionCN: 有固定程序的正式公开活动

entries.definition: a building where plays or films are shown
entries.definitionCN: 演出戏剧或放映电影的场所

entries.definition: a story recorded in moving pictures
entries.definitionCN: 用活动画面记录的故事

entries.definition: a work of moving pictures with sound
entries.definitionCN: 带声音的活动影像作品

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek movement root, the three senses and the everyday phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用希腊语「运动」词根、三层意思以及日常搭配。

normal.en: Cinema starts from the Greek word for movement, because films move.
normal.cn: cinema 出自希腊语表示运动的词，因为电影本来就是动的。

normal.en: The long machine name cinematographe was cut down, and cinema kept the middle.
normal.cn: 长长的机器名 cinematographe 被截短，cinema 留下了中间一段。

normal.en: Go to the cinema names the place, while work in the cinema names the art.
normal.cn: go to the cinema 指场所，work in the cinema 指艺术。

normal.en: Cinematic is the adjective and cinematography is the craft of the camera.
normal.cn: cinematic 是形容词，cinematography 是掌镜的技艺。

normal.en: A cinephile loves films, built from the short stem cine.
normal.cn: cinephile 是爱电影的人，由短词干 cine 构成。

abstract.en: Picture dust floating in the beam above a dark row of seats.
abstract.cn: 想象一束光里浮着灰尘，下面是一排排黑暗的座位。

abstract.en: Picture a white screen waking up with a slow picture.
abstract.cn: 想象白色银幕上缓缓浮出画面。

abstract.en: Picture a reel of film turning behind a small window.
abstract.cn: 想象一小格窗口后面转动的胶片盘。

examples.en: The cinema was almost empty that night.
examples.cn: 那晚电影院里几乎没人。

examples.en: She has written about the cinema for years.
examples.cn: 她写电影方面的文章已有多年。

examples.en: We met outside the cinema at seven.
examples.cn: 我们七点在电影院外碰面。

dict_mnemonic.text: cinema 的开头 cine 听起来像「看你」：黑暗里一群人一起看你。

root: 源自希腊语 kinema（运动），经法语 cinematographe（活动影像机）缩略为 cinema，本指放映活动影像的场所。

sensesIntro.en: A machine for movement gives its short name to the hall, then to the art and to a single showing.
sensesIntro.cn: 记录运动的机器把短名让给厅堂，再让给艺术与单场放映。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beam of light cutting through a dark hall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束光切过黑暗的放映厅。

branches.en: The hall is the most common everyday sense.
branches.cn: 厅堂是最常见的日常义项。

branches.en: The art sense grew from the pictures themselves.
branches.cn: 艺术义从画面本身生长出来。

branches.en: One showing is the place sense narrowed to a time.
branches.cn: 单场放映是场所义收窄到某个时段。

branches.en: A hall and its evening showing share one word.
branches.cn: 厅堂与它的晚场共用一个词。

branches.en: The building serves an art that became an industry.
branches.cn: 这座建筑服务于一种后来成为产业的艺术。

intro.en: The short stem cine supports a plural, an adjective, a craft noun and a lover compound.
intro.cn: 短词干 cine 支撑复数、形容词、技艺名词以及一个表示爱好者的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Greek kinema lies behind cinema, and -graphy adds the sense of writing or recording.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kinema 是 cinema 的前身，-graphy 添加记录或书写的含义。

items.meaning: a place where films are shown

items.exampleCN: 去年有两家电影院关门了。

items.example: A cinephile knows every old film.

items.exampleCN: cine- 出现在 cinephile 里。

latinEntries.example: Kinema is the oldest layer of cinema.
latinEntries.exampleCN: kinema 是 cinema 最古老的一层。

definition_en: a perfectly round closed shape, a group of people with a shared interest, or to move in a round path around something
core_image: 粉笔在黑板上画出的一个闭合圆圈
scene: 孩子们手拉手站在操场上，围成一个不断开的形状。The children sat in a circle on the floor.
sceneCN: 这里 circle 指「圆圈」（第 1 个义项：首尾相接的圆形）；句意是孩子们围坐在地上，围成一个圆圈。

senses.title: A round closed shape
senses.definition: a perfectly round shape whose edge is the same distance from the centre everywhere
senses.definitionCN: 边缘到中心距离处处相等的正圆形状
senses.example: He drew a circle on the board.
senses.exampleCN: 他在黑板上画了一个圆。
senses.why: Latin circulus meant a small ring, and the ring shape kept the name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circulus 指小圆环，环形这个形状保留了这个名字。

senses.title: A group of people
senses.definition: a group of people who share an interest or a way of life
senses.definitionCN: 有共同兴趣或生活方式的一群人
senses.example: She has a small circle of close friends.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一个小小的密友圈子。
senses.why: People standing in a ring around a speaker became a social group.
senses.whyCN: 围着说话人站成一圈的人，逐渐成了一群社交伙伴。

senses.title: To move around something
senses.definition: to move in a round path around something
senses.definitionCN: 沿圆形路线绕某物移动
senses.example: The plane circled the city twice.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机绕着城市飞了两圈。
senses.why: The noun of a ring turned into a verb of going round.
senses.whyCN: 表示圆环的名词转成了绕行的动词。

intro.en: Circle comes from the Latin word for a small ring.
intro.cn: circle 源自拉丁语中表示小圆环的词。

items.en: Circus named a ring or a circular arena.
items.cn: circus 指圆环或环形场地。

items.en: Circulus was the small ring built from circus.
items.cn: circulus 是由 circus 构成的指小形式，意为小圆环。

items.en: Cercle carried the shape word into French.
items.cn: cercle 把这个表示形状的词带进法语。

items.en: English circle named the shape and the ring of people.
items.cn: 英语 circle 兼指形状与围成圈的人群。

items.en: The noun produced a verb meaning to go round.
items.cn: 这个名词又生出表示绕行的动词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names round forms.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出各种圆形与环状物。

entries.definition: a show with clowns and acrobats
a closed path for electric current
shaped like a circle
a round band or a round shape
a curve that crosses itself
shaped like a circle or a ball

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the circus root, the ring of people and the verb of going round.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 circus 词根、围成圈的人群以及绕行的动词义。

normal.en: Circle and circus share a root: a circus is played inside a big ring.
normal.cn: circle 与 circus 同根：马戏就是在一个大圆环里演的。

normal.en: Latin circulus was a small ring, and the -cle ending still sounds small.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 circulus 是小圆环，-cle 词尾至今听起来仍显小。

normal.en: A circle of friends keeps the shape image: people standing around one centre.
normal.cn: a circle of friends 保留了形状意象：人围着一个中心站。

normal.en: The verb circles needs no preposition of direction, because the path itself is closed.
normal.cn: 动词 circle 不需要方向介词，因为路线本身就是闭合的。

normal.en: Circular, circulate and semicircle all grow from the same ring.
normal.cn: circular、circulate 与 semicircle 都从同一个圆环长出来。

abstract.en: Picture chalk travelling around and closing exactly where it began.
abstract.cn: 想象粉笔一路转过去，正好在起点合上。

abstract.en: Picture a ring of chairs with one lamp in the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈椅子，中间放着一盏灯。

abstract.en: Picture a plane leaving a pale ring above a sleeping town.
abstract.cn: 想象飞机在沉睡的城镇上空留下一圈淡痕。

examples.en: Draw a circle and mark its centre.
examples.cn: 画一个圆，并标出它的圆心。

examples.en: The discussion moved in circles for an hour.
examples.cn: 讨论绕了一个小时的圈子。

examples.en: Birds circled above the empty field.
examples.cn: 鸟在空旷的田野上方盘旋。

dict_mnemonic.text: circle 与 circus 同源：马戏场本来就是一个大圆环。

root: 源自拉丁语 circulus（小圆环），是 circus（环形场地）的指小形式，经古法语 cercle 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: A small ring gives the shape, then the ring of people, and finally the act of going round.
sensesIntro.cn: 小圆环先给出形状，再给出围成圈的人，最后给出绕行的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: chalk closing a perfect ring on a board.
core.cn: 核心意象：粉笔在黑板上合拢成一个完美的环。

branches.en: The geometric shape is the first and plainest sense.
branches.cn: 几何形状是最先也最朴素的一义。

branches.en: People arranged in a ring become a social circle.
branches.cn: 排成环的人成了一个社交圈子。

branches.en: The noun of a ring gives the verb of moving round.
branches.cn: 圆环名词给出表示绕行的动词。

branches.en: The shape and the motion share one closed path.
branches.cn: 形状与动作共享同一条闭合路线。

branches.en: A circle of friends also closes around a centre.
branches.cn: 朋友圈子同样围绕一个中心合拢。

intro.en: The stem circle builds a plural, a verb family and three Latin relatives.
intro.cn: 词干 circle 构成复数、一组动词以及三个拉丁语亲族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circulus, a small circus, is the source of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circulus 是一个小 circus，是整个词族的来源。

items.example: The circle is ten metres across.
The stone left circles in the water.
items.exampleCN: 石头在水面留下一圈圈波纹。

items.example: The hawk circled the tower once.
The dog was circling the chair.
They sat at a circular table.
items.exampleCN: 他们围坐在一张圆桌旁。

items.meaning: a small version of the base
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -cle 出现在 circle 中。

latinEntries.example: Circulus is the direct source of circle.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circulus 是 circle 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circus gave circulus its ring shape.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circus 赋予了 circulus 圆环的形状。

definition_en: a complete path through which electric current flows, a route that returns to its start, or a regular round of visits
core_image: 电流沿着一圈导线跑回起点
scene: 桌上摊着一块电路板，指示灯一闪一闪。A loose wire broke the circuit.
sceneCN: 这里 circuit 指「电路」（第 1 个义项：电流可以流过的闭合路径）；句意是一根松脱的导线让电路断开了。

senses.title: A closed path for current
senses.definition: a complete path through which electric current can flow
senses.definitionCN: 电流可以流过的完整路径
senses.example: A loose wire broke the circuit.
senses.exampleCN: 一根松脱的导线让电路断开了。
senses.why: Latin circuitus meant a going around, and electricity repeats that closed loop.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circuitus 意为绕行，电流重复的正是这种闭合环路。

senses.title: A circular route
senses.definition: a route that goes around and comes back to the start
senses.definitionCN: 绕一圈后回到起点的路线
senses.example: The race covers a five kilometre circuit.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛跑一圈五公里的环道。
senses.why: The going-around sense named any path that returns on itself.
senses.whyCN: 绕行的意思用来指任何自身闭合的路线。

senses.title: A regular round of visits
senses.definition: a regular series of visits to several places in turn
senses.definitionCN: 依次到多个地点的一轮例行访问
senses.example: The judge travels a country circuit.
senses.exampleCN: 这位法官在乡间巡回审案。
senses.why: Officials who rode from town to town completed a ring of visits.
senses.whyCN: 官员从一镇走到另一镇，正好走完一圈行程。

intro.en: Circuit is Latin for a going around, built from around plus to go.
intro.cn: circuit 在拉丁语中意为绕行，由「周围」与「走」两部分构成。

items.en: Circum meant around on every side.
items.cn: circum 意为四周环绕。

items.en: Ire meant to go.
items.cn: ire 意为走。

items.en: Circuitus named the act of going round.
items.cn: circuitus 指绕行这一动作。

items.en: Circuit kept the legal and travelling senses.
items.cn: circuit 保留了法律与巡行的意思。

items.en: English used circuit for a judge's round of towns.
items.cn: 英语用 circuit 指法官巡视各镇的行程。

items.en: Electricity gave the word its most familiar sense.
items.cn: 电学赋予这个词最熟悉的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names paths and routes.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出路径与路线。

entries.definition: a round closed shape
shaped like a circle
a show performed in a ring
entries.definitionCN: 在圆环场地演出的表演

entries.definition: a path that returns to itself
a way from one place to another
a line along which something moves

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Latin parts, the electric loop and the judge's round.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用两个拉丁语部件、电流环路以及法官巡行。

normal.en: Split circuit into circu and it: a ring plus a going, so a going round.
normal.cn: 把 circuit 拆成 circu 与 it：一个圈加一次走，就是绕一圈。

normal.en: A broken circuit stops the current because the ring is no longer closed.
normal.cn: 电路断了电流就停，因为那个环不再闭合。

normal.en: Short circuit skips the long path, and short-circuit as a verb means to bypass.
normal.cn: 短路跳过了长路径，动词 short-circuit 便表示绕过。

normal.en: The racing circuit is a loop of road, and the lecture circuit is a loop of towns.
normal.cn: 赛车环道是一圈路，巡回讲学是一圈城镇。

normal.en: Circuitous keeps the going-around idea in adjective form.
normal.cn: circuitous 以形容词形式保留绕行的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a thin wire returning to the battery it left.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细导线回到它出发的那块电池。

abstract.en: Picture a car passing the same grandstand again.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆车再次经过同一座看台。

abstract.en: Picture a judge's carriage stopping in one more market square.
abstract.cn: 想象法官的马车又在另一个集市广场停下。

examples.en: Water got into the circuit and stopped the machine.
examples.cn: 水进了电路，机器停了下来。

examples.en: They drove one full circuit of the park.
examples.cn: 他们绕公园整整开了一圈。

examples.en: The band spent the summer on the festival circuit.
examples.cn: 乐队整个夏天都在音乐节巡回演出。

dict_mnemonic.text: circuit 拆成 circu 与 it：绕一圈，再走回来。

root: 源自拉丁语 circuitus（绕行），由 circum（周围）与 ire（走）构成，本指走一圈回到原处。

sensesIntro.en: A going around gives the closed path, then any returning route, and then a round of official visits.
sensesIntro.cn: 绕行先给出闭合路径，再给出任何回到原处的路线，最后给出官员的一轮巡访。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a current running a ring of wire back to its source.
core.cn: 核心意象：电流沿一圈导线跑回它的源头。

branches.en: The electric loop is the modern everyday sense.
branches.cn: 电流环路是现代最日常的义项。

branches.en: Any route that returns is a circuit of road.
branches.cn: 任何回到原处的路线都是一圈道路。

branches.en: A judge's round of towns repeats the ring on a map.
branches.cn: 法官巡行各镇，在地图上重复同一个环。

branches.en: Wire and road share one closed geometry.
branches.cn: 导线与道路共享同一个闭合几何。

branches.en: A racing loop and a lecture loop both end where they began.
branches.cn: 赛车环道与巡回讲学都在起点结束。

intro.en: The stem circuit builds a plural, two derived adjectives and a compound verb.
intro.cn: 词干 circuit 构成复数、两个派生形容词以及一个复合动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circum around plus ire to go produced circuitus, the base of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circum（周围）加 ire（走）构成 circuitus，是整个词族的词基。

items.exampleCN: 这块板上集成了三条电路。
我们走了一条绕远的路。
circum- 是 circuit 的开头。

latinEntries.example: Circuitus is the direct source of circuit.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circuitus 是 circuit 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circumire combines around with to go.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circumire 把周围与走合在一起。

definition_en: the facts and conditions that affect an event, the conditions of a person's life, or a person's financial position
core_image: 一个人站在四周密密麻麻的条件中间
scene: 雨下得很大，末班车又提前开走了。Under the circumstances, we decided to stay.
sceneCN: 这里 circumstances 指「情况」（第 1 个义项：影响某个决定的周边事实）；句意是在这种情况下，我们决定留下。

senses.title: The facts around an event
senses.definition: the facts and conditions that affect an event or a decision
senses.definitionCN: 影响某个事件或决定的周边事实与条件
senses.example: Under the circumstances, we decided to stay.
senses.exampleCN: 在这种情况下，我们决定留下。
senses.why: Latin circumstantia meant standing around, so the facts standing around an event took the name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circumstantia 意为站在四周，围绕事件的事实便得了这个名字。

senses.title: Surrounding conditions
senses.definition: the conditions of life that surround a person or a group
senses.definitionCN: 围绕一个人或一群人的生活条件
senses.example: Children here grow up in difficult circumstances.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的孩子在艰难的环境中长大。
senses.why: What stands around a person forms the setting of a whole life.
senses.whyCN: 围绕一个人站立的东西，构成了整段生活的背景。

senses.title: Financial position
senses.definition: the level of money and comfort of a person or a family
senses.definitionCN: 个人或家庭的金钱与生活水平
senses.example: Her circumstances improved after the new job.
senses.exampleCN: 新工作之后她的境况好转了。
senses.why: Money became the measure of the ground a person stands on.
senses.whyCN: 金钱成了衡量一个人脚下立足之地的尺度。

intro.en: Circumstance is Latin for a standing around, as conditions stand around an event.
intro.cn: circumstance 在拉丁语中意为「站在四周」，正如条件围绕事件而立。

items.en: Circum meant around on every side.
items.cn: circum 意为四周环绕。

items.en: Stare meant to stand.
items.cn: stare 意为站立。

items.en: Circumstantia named the things standing around.
items.cn: circumstantia 指站在四周的事物。

items.en: Circonstance carried the word into French.
items.cn: circonstance 把这个词带进法语。

items.en: English circumstance named the setting of an act.
items.cn: 英语 circumstance 指一个行为的背景。

items.en: The plural widened to life conditions and money.
items.cn: 复数形式扩展到生活条件与金钱状况。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the circum- opening, while the meaning group names settings and conditions.
note.cn: 形近组共享 circum- 开头，近义组列出背景与条件。

entries.definition: the distance around the edge of a circle
based on indirect evidence
to find a way around a rule
the set of things happening at a time
entries.definitionCN: 某一时刻发生的一整套事情

entries.definition: the state that something is in
the facts around an event or a word
entries.definitionCN: 围绕事件或词语的事实

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the standing-around image, the three senses and the fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用「站在四周」的意象、三层意思以及固定搭配。

normal.en: Split circumstance into circum and stance: everything standing around you.
normal.cn: 把 circumstance 拆成 circum 与 stance：站在你四周的一切。

normal.en: Under the circumstances is the most common frame, meaning because of the facts.
normal.cn: under the circumstances 是最常见的框架，意为「鉴于这些事实」。

normal.en: Under no circumstances is a strong refusal, and it keeps the same plural shape.
normal.cn: under no circumstances 表示坚决否定，形状仍是复数。

normal.en: The plural is normal, because many conditions stand around one event.
normal.cn: 通常用复数，因为围绕一个事件的条件有很多。

normal.en: Circumstantial evidence is evidence from the things standing around a case.
normal.cn: circumstantial evidence 就是来自案件周边事物的证据。

abstract.en: Picture a person standing still while rain, traffic and clock hands press in.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站住不动，雨、车流与钟表的指针都压过来。

abstract.en: Picture a small family in a narrow room with one lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小家庭挤在有盏灯的窄房间里。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of bills on a kitchen table.
abstract.cn: 想象厨房桌上放着一叠账单。

examples.en: Under the circumstances, the delay was understandable.
examples.cn: 在这种情况下，延误是可以理解的。

examples.en: Many families live in hard circumstances.
examples.cn: 许多家庭生活在艰苦的环境中。

examples.en: He rose above his circumstances through study.
examples.cn: 他靠学习摆脱了自己的境况。

dict_mnemonic.text: circumstance 拆成 circum 与 stance：站在你周围的一切，就是你的处境。

root: 源自拉丁语 circumstantia（站在四周），由 circum（周围）与 stare（站立）构成，本指围绕事件的条件。

sensesIntro.en: Things standing around an act give the case facts, then the setting of a life, and finally the money a person stands on.
sensesIntro.cn: 围绕行为而立的事物先给出具体情况，再给出生活背景，最后给出一个人脚下的钱财。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure standing in the middle of pressing conditions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在层层条件包围的中间。

branches.en: The facts of a case are the first sense.
branches.cn: 案件的具体事实是第一层意思。

branches.en: The setting of a life is the plural at work.
branches.cn: 生活背景是复数形式的常见用法。

branches.en: Money is the narrowest and most personal sense.
branches.cn: 金钱是最窄也最贴近个人的义项。

branches.en: One event and a whole life both sit inside conditions.
branches.cn: 单个事件与整段人生都坐在条件之中。

branches.en: Money decides much of the ground a family stands on.
branches.cn: 金钱决定了一个家庭脚下的大部分立足之地。

intro.en: The stem builds a plural, an adjective and an adverb from one Latin frame.
intro.cn: 这个词干在一个拉丁框架上构成复数、形容词与副词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circum around plus stare to stand produced circumstantia, the base of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circum（周围）加 stare（站立）构成 circumstantia，是整个词族的词基。

items.exampleCN: 当时的情况对我们不利。

items.example: The case rested on circumstantial proof.

items.exampleCN: 这一关联是以间接方式证明的。
circum- 是 circumstance 的开头。

items.example: Stance carries the sense of standing.

latinEntries.example: Circumstantia is the direct source of circumstance.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circumstantia 是 circumstance 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circumstare joins around with to stand.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circumstare 把周围与站立合在一起。

definition_en: a person who legally belongs to a country and has rights there, a person who lives in a city, or an ordinary person
core_image: 投票站门口排队的人手里捏着证件
scene: 投票站门口排起长队，人们手里捏着证件。Every citizen has the right to vote.
sceneCN: 这里 citizen 指「公民」（第 1 个义项：在法律上属于某国并享有权利的人）；句意是每个公民都有投票权。

senses.title: A member of a state
senses.definition: a person who legally belongs to a country and has rights there
senses.definitionCN: 在法律上属于某国并享有权利的人
senses.example: Every citizen has the right to vote.
senses.exampleCN: 每个公民都有投票权。
senses.why: Latin civitas named the body of people in a city state, and one member of it became a citizen.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 civitas 指城邦中的全体人民，其中一员便成了公民。

senses.title: A person of a city
senses.definition: a person who lives in a particular city
senses.definitionCN: 居住在某座城市的人
senses.example: The citizens of the town built the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城的市民修建了那座桥。
senses.why: The word began with the city, and the town sense is the older local one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本与城市相连，城镇义是更早的地方性含义。

senses.title: An ordinary person
senses.definition: an ordinary person rather than an official or a soldier
senses.definitionCN: 相对于官员或军人而言的普通人
senses.example: The mayor met a few private citizens.
senses.exampleCN: 市长见了几位普通公民。
senses.why: Anyone who belongs to the community can be set against those in office.
senses.whyCN: 任何属于这个共同体的人，都可以与在任者相对。

intro.en: Citizen reaches back to the Latin word for a member of a city state.
intro.cn: citizen 可上溯到拉丁语中指城邦成员的词。

items.en: Civis meant a citizen of a city state.
items.cn: civis 意为城邦的公民。

items.en: Civitas named the whole community of citizens.
items.cn: civitas 指全体公民构成的共同体。

items.en: Citeain named a townsman of a walled city.
items.cn: citeain 指有城墙的城市里的市民。

items.en: English citizen kept both the town and the state sense.
items.cn: 英语 citizen 同时保留城市与国家两层意思。

items.en: The word widened to the legal member of any modern state.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到现代任何国家的法定成员。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cit- shape, while the meaning group names people who belong to a place.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cit- 形状，近义组列出属于某地的人。

entries.definition: a large and important town
the legal status of a citizen
relating to citizens or to ordinary life
entries.definitionCN: 与公民或日常生活有关的

entries.definition: a person who lives in a place
a person who belongs to a country
a person under the rule of a monarch

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the city inside the word, the voting image and the three senses.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用词里的 city、投票意象以及三层意思。

normal.en: Citizen hides city at its front: a citizen began as a member of a city.
normal.cn: citizen 前面藏着 city：公民最初就是城中的一员。

normal.en: The suffix -ship turns the person into the legal status, citizenship.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ship 把人变成法定身份，即 citizenship。

normal.en: A senior citizen is an older person, a polite phrase built on the same word.
normal.cn: a senior citizen 是对老年人的客气说法，用的也是这个词。

normal.en: A citizen of the world belongs everywhere and nowhere in particular.
normal.cn: a citizen of the world 指四海为家、不属于某一地的人。

normal.en: A private citizen stands apart from officials and soldiers.
normal.cn: private citizen 指与官员和军人相对的普通人。

abstract.en: Picture a hand holding a small card at the door of a polling station.
abstract.cn: 想象投票站门口一只手捏着一张小卡片。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd building a wooden bridge over a stream.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人在溪流上搭一座木桥。

abstract.en: Picture an ordinary man shaking hands with a mayor.
abstract.cn: 想象一位普通人与市长握手。

examples.en: She became a citizen after ten years in the country.
examples.cn: 在这个国家住了十年之后，她取得了公民身份。

examples.en: The citizens of the town voted for a new library.
examples.cn: 这座城的市民投票支持新建图书馆。

examples.en: Every citizen should know the basic law.
examples.cn: 每个公民都应了解基本法律。

dict_mnemonic.text: citizen 里藏着 city：住在城里的人，先被称作市民。

root: 源自拉丁语 civis（公民），经 civitas（城邦共同体）与古法语 citeain 进入英语，本指城邦中的一员。

sensesIntro.en: A member of the city community becomes a member of the state, and finally any ordinary person.
sensesIntro.cn: 城邦共同体中的一员先成为国家成员，最后泛指任何普通人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a card held tight at a polling station door.
core.cn: 核心意象：投票站门口被紧紧捏住的一张证件。

branches.en: The legal member of a state is the main modern sense.
branches.cn: 国家的法定成员是现代主要义项。

branches.en: The townsman sense is the older local one.
branches.cn: 市民义是更早的地方性含义。

branches.en: An ordinary person is set against officials.
branches.cn: 普通人义是与官员相对而言的。

branches.en: City and state both claim the same member.
branches.cn: 城市与国家都称同一个人为自己的成员。

branches.en: Rights make a citizen more than a mere resident.
branches.cn: 权利使公民不止是一个居住者。

intro.en: The stem citizen builds a plural, a status noun and a collective noun.
intro.cn: 词干 citizen 构成复数、身份名词与集合名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin civis and civitas stand behind citizen, with -ship added in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 civis 与 civitas 是 citizen 的前身，-ship 是英语后加的。

items.exampleCN: 一位公民提出了这个问题。

items.meaning: the position of being a citizen

items.exampleCN: 全体公民支持这项计划。

items.example: The city grew around the river.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市沿河发展起来。

items.example: Civil duties are shared by all.
items.exampleCN: 公民义务由所有人分担。

latinEntries.example: Civis is the oldest layer of citizen.
latinEntries.exampleCN: civis 是 citizen 最古老的一层。

latinEntries.example: Civitas gave the word its town sense.
latinEntries.exampleCN: civitas 赋予这个词城市义。

definition_en: a large and important town, a town with special official status, or the people who live in such a place
core_image: 高楼与街道挤在一起，夜里灯光连成一片
scene: 天快黑时，整片街区一盏盏亮起来。The city never seems to sleep.
sceneCN: 这里 city 指「城市」（第 1 个义项：人口密集、规模较大的聚居地）；句意是这座城市似乎从不入睡。

senses.title: A large town
senses.definition: a large and important town where many people live and work
senses.definitionCN: 人口稠密、规模较大的重要城镇
senses.example: The city never seems to sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市似乎从不入睡。
senses.why: Latin civitas meant the community of citizens, and the place they formed took the name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 civitas 指公民共同体，他们形成的那个地方便得了这个名字。

senses.title: An official unit
senses.definition: a town that has been given a special official status
senses.definitionCN: 被赋予特殊官方地位的城镇
senses.example: The city runs its own transport system.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市自行管理交通系统。
senses.why: A charter turned a town into a city with its own government.
senses.whyCN: 一张特许状把一座镇变成拥有自治政府的市。

senses.title: The people of a city
senses.definition: the people who live in a city, treated as one group
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体看待的城市居民
senses.example: The whole city came out to watch.
senses.exampleCN: 全城的人都出来观看。
senses.why: A place name often shifts to the people gathered in it.
senses.whyCN: 地名常常转指聚集在其中的居民。

intro.en: City is the modern form of the Latin word for a citizen community.
intro.cn: city 是拉丁语中表示公民共同体的词的现代形式。

items.en: Civis meant a citizen.
items.cn: civis 意为公民。

items.en: Civitas meant citizenship and the whole community.
items.cn: civitas 意为公民身份与整个共同体。

items.en: Cite named the walled town of those citizens.
items.cn: cite 指这些公民所居的有城墙的城镇。

items.en: English city named a cathedral town with a charter.
items.cn: 英语 city 指拥有特许状的设主教座堂的城镇。

items.en: The word widened to any large urban place.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到任何大型城市地区。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cit- shape, while the meaning group names kinds of settlement.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cit- 形状，近义组列出不同类型的聚居地。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the citizen link, the lights at night and the charter history.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用与 citizen 的关联、夜间灯火以及特许状历史。

normal.en: City and citizen share one root: a city is where its citizens live.
normal.cn: city 与 citizen 同根：城市就是市民居住的地方。

normal.en: The plural cities changes y to i, so remember the ies ending.
normal.cn: 复数 cities 把 y 变成 i，要记住 ies 词尾。

normal.en: City centre, city life, city council: three phrases all use the bare noun.
normal.cn: city centre、city life、city council，三个搭配都用光秃秃的名词。

normal.en: A city once needed a charter, which is why the word sounds official.
normal.cn: city 在旧时需要特许状，所以这个词听起来带着官方味。

normal.en: Civic is the adjective, and citywide means across the whole city.
normal.cn: civic 是形容词，citywide 意为遍及全城。

abstract.en: Picture windows lighting up one by one across a dark block.
abstract.cn: 想象一整片暗下来的街区，窗户一扇扇亮起。

abstract.en: Picture buses and taxis braiding the same wide street.
abstract.cn: 想象公交车与出租车在同一条大街上交织。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd filling a square to watch one screen.
abstract.cn: 想象人群挤满广场，一起看一块屏幕。

examples.en: The city grew quickly after the railway came.
examples.cn: 铁路通车后这座城市发展得很快。

examples.en: They moved from a village to a big city.
examples.cn: 他们从村庄搬到了大城市。

examples.en: The whole city was talking about the match.
examples.cn: 全城的人都在谈论那场比赛。

sensesIntro.en: A citizen community gives the place, a charter gives the official unit, and the place name finally shifts to its people.
sensesIntro.cn: 公民共同体先给出地点，特许状给出行政单位，地名最后转指城中的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a block of windows lighting up at dusk.
core.cn: 核心意象：黄昏时一整片窗户陆续亮起。

branches.en: A large town is the plain modern sense.
branches.cn: 大型城镇是朴素的现代义项。

branches.en: The official unit sense grew from the royal charter.
branches.cn: 行政单位义从王室特许状生长出来。

branches.en: The people of the place take its name by metonymy.
branches.cn: 城中的人通过借代取得这个地名。

branches.en: Size and charter both mark a place as a city.
branches.cn: 规模与特许状都标志一个地方是城市。

branches.en: A city is both its streets and its residents.
branches.cn: 城市既是它的街道，也是它的居民。

intro.en: The stem city builds a plural, an adjective and two wide compounds.
intro.cn: 词干 city 构成复数、一个形容词以及两个范围类复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin civitas and civis lie behind city and its relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 civitas 与 civis 是 city 及其亲族词的前身。

items.example: The city is quiet on Sundays.

definition_zh: 公民的；民事的；文明的；国内的
definition_en: relating to the private rights of citizens, polite and well mannered, or happening inside one country
core_image: 法庭上两边各坐一人，中间没有刀剑
scene: 两位邻居为一道篱笆争了很久，最后走进法庭。The two families settled the dispute through civil action.
sceneCN: 这里 civil 指「民事的」（第 1 个义项：与公民私人权利有关的）；句意是两家通过民事诉讼解决了争端。

pos.zh: 公民的；民事的；文明的；国内的

senses.title: Relating to private citizens
senses.definition: relating to the private rights of citizens rather than to crime or the army
senses.definitionCN: 与公民私人权利有关，而非刑事或军事
senses.example: The case went to a civil court.
senses.exampleCN: 这个案子提交民事法庭审理。
senses.why: Latin civilis meant of a citizen, and citizen law grew beside military and criminal law.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 civilis 意为公民的，公民之法与军事、刑法并列而生。

senses.title: Polite and well mannered
senses.definition: polite and respectful in behaviour towards others
senses.definitionCN: 举止有礼并尊重他人
senses.example: He gave a civil answer even under attack.
senses.exampleCN: 即使受到攻击，他的回答依然有礼。
senses.why: Life in a citizen community required courtesy between equals.
senses.whyCN: 公民共同体中的生活要求平等者之间以礼相待。

senses.title: Inside one country
senses.definition: happening between groups within the same country
senses.definitionCN: 发生在同一国家内部各群体之间的
senses.example: The country suffered a long civil war.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家经历了一场漫长的内战。
senses.why: A war among citizens of one state is a citizen war, shortened to civil.
senses.whyCN: 同一国家公民之间的战争即公民之战，缩略为 civil。

intro.en: Civil is the Latin adjective of the citizen, and it still carries that frame.
intro.cn: civil 是拉丁语中「公民」的形容词，至今仍带着这个框架。

items.en: Civis meant a citizen.
items.cn: civis 意为公民。

items.en: Civilis meant belonging to a citizen.
items.cn: civilis 意为属于公民的。

items.en: Civil kept the legal and the courteous senses.
items.cn: civil 同时保留法律义与礼貌义。

items.en: English civil first described citizen law.
items.cn: 英语 civil 最初描述公民之法。

items.en: The word extended to good manners and to wars inside a state.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到良好举止与国家内部的战争。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cit- root, while the meaning group names politeness and domestic matters.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cit- 词根，近义组列出礼貌与国内事务。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the citizen root, the courtroom image and the three sense families.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用公民词根、法庭意象以及三组意思。

normal.en: Civil and city share one root: civil matters belong to citizens of a city.
normal.cn: civil 与 city 同根：民事的事属于城里的公民。

normal.en: Civil law sits beside criminal law, and civil war sits inside one state.
normal.cn: 民法与刑法并列，内战则发生在一国之内。

normal.en: A civil answer is polite, because citizens must live together.
normal.cn: a civil answer 是有礼的回答，因为公民必须共同生活。

normal.en: Civil servants serve the state, and civil rights belong to the person.
normal.cn: civil servant 为国家服务，civil right 属于个人。

normal.en: Civility is the noun of polite behaviour, and civilization is the wider society.
normal.cn: civility 是有礼行为的名词，civilization 则指更广的社会文明。

abstract.en: Picture two neighbours sitting quietly at a long wooden table.
abstract.cn: 想象两位邻居安静地坐在一张长木桌两边。

abstract.en: Picture a queue of people waiting without pushing.
abstract.cn: 想象一队人不推不挤地等着。

abstract.en: Picture a map of one country split by a line of smoke.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图被一道烟线从中分开。

examples.en: The dispute was settled in a civil court.
examples.cn: 这场争端在民事法庭上解决了。

examples.en: He remained civil even when the crowd shouted.
examples.cn: 即使人群喊叫，他仍然保持礼貌。

examples.en: The civil war lasted almost ten years.
examples.cn: 这场内战持续了将近十年。

dict_mnemonic.text: civil 与 city 同根：城里人相处要有礼，纠纷走民事。

root: 源自拉丁语 civilis（公民的），由 civis（公民）加形容词后缀构成，本指与公民有关。

sensesIntro.en: Citizen law gives the legal sense, life among equals gives politeness, and conflict inside a state gives the war sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 公民之法给出法律义，平等者之间的生活给出礼貌义，国家内部的冲突给出战争义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two parties seated with no weapons between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两方相对而坐，中间没有武器。

branches.en: The legal sense is the oldest and most technical.
branches.cn: 法律义最古老也最专业。

branches.en: Polite manners come from life among equal citizens.
branches.cn: 礼貌义来自平等公民之间的生活。

branches.en: A war inside one state is a citizen war.
branches.cn: 一国之内发生的战争即公民之战。

branches.en: Law and courtesy both keep citizens together.
branches.cn: 法律与礼貌都在维系公民的共处。

branches.en: Civil law and civil war both stay inside the state.
branches.cn: 民法与内战都发生在国家内部。

intro.en: The adjective stem builds adverbs, nouns and the whole civilization family.
intro.cn: 这个形容词词干构成副词、名词以及整个 civilization 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin civilis comes from civis, and the suffixes -ian and -ity grew on the same stem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 civilis 出自 civis，后缀 -ian 与 -ity 也长在同一个词干上。

definition_zh: 声称；断言；索取；认领；主张；权利要求
definition_en: to say that something is true when others may doubt it, to ask for something as your right, or a right that you say you have
core_image: 一只手举着一张写有自己名字的单据
scene: 保险员把表格推过来，笔尖停在签名处。Two men claim the same wallet at the front desk.
sceneCN: 这里 claim 指「认领」（第 2 个义项：主张某物归自己所有）；句意是两个男人在前台都声称那个钱包是自己的。

senses.title: To state as true
senses.definition: to say that something is true when other people may not believe it
senses.definitionCN: 在别人可能不相信时仍说某事为真
senses.example: She claims the keys were left on the desk.
senses.exampleCN: 她声称钥匙是落在桌子上的。
senses.why: The old verb meant to cry out, so a claim is something said loudly and publicly.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老动词本指大声喊出，因此 claim 是被大声公开说出来的话。

senses.title: To demand as your own
senses.definition: to ask for something that you believe belongs to you by right
senses.definitionCN: 要求得到你认为按权利属于自己的东西
senses.example: He claimed his luggage at the counter.
senses.exampleCN: 他在柜台认领了自己的行李。
senses.why: A public cry for something became a formal demand for property or payment.
senses.whyCN: 公开喊出某物，演变成对财产或款项的正式要求。

senses.title: A right or a demand
senses.definition: a statement that you have a right to something, or that right itself
senses.definitionCN: 关于你有权得到某物的声明，或该项权利本身
senses.example: Her claim to the land was never proved.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这块土地的所有权主张从未得到证实。
senses.why: The noun took the same shape as the verb and named the demand rather than the act of demanding.
senses.whyCN: 名词与动词同形，但它指所提的要求，而不是提出要求的动作。

intro.en: Claim comes from a Latin verb meaning to cry out, which also gave English exclaim and proclaim.
intro.cn: claim 出自拉丁语中表示大声喊出的动词，exclaim 与 proclaim 也来自它。

items.en: Clamare meant to cry out or call loudly.
items.cn: clamare 意为大声喊叫或呼喊。

items.en: Clamer carried the sense of calling out a demand.
items.cn: clamer 带有喊出一项要求的含义。

items.en: English took the word as claimen in law and argument.
items.cn: 英语以 claimen 的形式把它用于法律与辩论。

items.en: A claim became a formal demand for land or money.
items.cn: claim 成为对土地或金钱的正式要求。

items.en: The verb widened to plain statements of fact.
items.cn: 这个动词扩展到对事实的普通陈述。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words with a similar shape, while the meaning group holds verbs of saying and demanding.
note.cn: 形近组列出外形相近的短词，近义组列出言说与要求类动词。

entries.definitionCN: 把东西紧紧夹住的工具

entries.definition: to hold something firmly with your hand
to praise someone loudly and publicly
to state something firmly as a fact
entries.definitionCN: 坚定地把某事说成事实

entries.definition: to announce something officially or clearly
entries.definitionCN: 正式或清楚地宣布某事

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the cry-out root, the legal demand and the noun-verb pair.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用呼喊词根、法律要求以及名动同形这三条线。

normal.en: Claim belongs with exclaim and proclaim; all three contain the Latin cry for a call.
normal.cn: claim 与 exclaim、proclaim 同族，三者都含拉丁语表示喊叫的部分。

normal.en: To claim is to put your hand up in public, either to speak or to take.
normal.cn: claim 就是在公开场合举手，要么发言，要么拿东西。

normal.en: The noun and the verb look the same, so a claim is both the act and the thing demanded.
normal.cn: 名词与动词同形，所以 claim 既是动作，也是所要求的对象。

normal.en: Insurance papers are full of claims, because a claim asks for money.
normal.cn: 保险文件里满是 claim，因为这个词可以指索赔。

normal.en: Lay claim to is the fixed phrase for ownership, not for an opinion.
normal.cn: lay claim to 是表示所有权的固定说法，不用来说看法。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raised at an auction with a numbered card.
abstract.cn: 想象拍卖会上举起一只拿着号牌的手。

abstract.en: Picture a luggage tag matching the name on a passport.
abstract.cn: 想象一张行李牌与护照上的名字对得上。

abstract.en: Picture a boundary line drawn on a map and then disputed.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上画出一条边界线，随后被人争执。

examples.en: She claims the keys were left on the desk.
examples.cn: 她声称钥匙是落在桌子上的。

examples.en: He claimed his luggage at the counter before the taxi came.
examples.cn: 出租车来之前，他在柜台认领了行李。

examples.en: The company made a claim for the damaged goods.
examples.cn: 公司就受损货物提出了索赔。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cl 想成「喊」，aim 想成「目标」：朝着目标喊一声，就是声明这东西归我。

root: 源自拉丁语 clamare（大声喊叫），经古法语 clamer 进入英语，本义是喊出自己的权利。

sensesIntro.en: A loud cry turns into an assertion, then into a demand, and finally into the right behind the demand.
sensesIntro.cn: 一声大喊先变成断言，再变成索求，最后变成索求背后的权利。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised hand holding a paper with a name on it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只举起的手拿着写有名字的纸。

branches.en: The old cry becomes a public statement of fact.
branches.cn: 古老的呼喊变成公开的事实陈述。

branches.en: The same cry becomes a request for what is yours.
branches.cn: 同样的呼喊变成对属于自己之物的索求。

branches.en: The noun names the demand and the right behind it.
branches.cn: 名词指所提的要求以及其背后的权利。

branches.en: Saying and taking share one verb because both are public acts.
branches.cn: 言说与索取共用一个动词，因为两者都是公开行为。

branches.en: A claim needs a right, and a right survives only if claimed.
branches.cn: 索求需要权利，而权利只有被主张才存在。

intro.en: One short verb grows a plural, two participles, an agent noun and two prefixed forms.
intro.cn: 一个短动词长出复数、两个分词、一个施动名词和两个前缀形式。

latinIntro.en: The base clamare also underlies exclaim, proclaim and acclaim, all built with Latin prefixes.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 clamare 也是 exclaim、proclaim、acclaim 的来源，这些词都加了拉丁语前缀。

latinEntries.exampleCN: clamare 给了英语 claim 与 exclaim。
